import os, pathlib
program_dir=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u018/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != background]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c] != background]

    def segments(length, bars):
        result, start = [], 0
        for bar in bars:
            if start < bar:
                result.append(list(range(start, bar)))
            start = bar + 1
        if start < length:
            result.append(list(range(start, length)))
        return result

    row_segments = segments(h, row_lines)
    col_segments = segments(w, col_lines)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    source_ri = 1 if len(row_lines) >= 2 else 0
    source_ci = 1 if len(col_lines) >= 2 else 0
    src_rows = row_segments[source_ri]
    src_cols = col_segments[source_ci]
    for ri, rows in enumerate(row_segments):
        for ci, cols in enumerate(col_segments):
            if ri == source_ri and ci == source_ci:
                continue
            for i, r in enumerate(rows):
                for j, c in enumerate(cols):
                    out[r][c] = grid[src_rows[i % len(src_rows)]][src_cols[j % len(src_cols)]]
    return out
'''
